description: A weakness visible in a call's own arguments, with no dataflow anywhere near it. Two broken hash algorithms named in the source are findings; SHA-256 is not; HMAC-SHA1 is not, because it is not broken the way a bare SHA-1 digest is and is deliberately absent from the list rather than swept in by association; and an algorithm chosen at runtime is not matched, because this kind matches literals and does not guess.

expected.note: the algorithm is written into the call
a bare SHA-1 digest, unlike HMAC-SHA1 below
